title: 第15章 秦淮再无虎爷第16章 苍玄小院
content_zh:
离开帝豪KTV，江凡、牧华伟、张兆庆等人没有走多远，沿着原路返回，坐在帝豪KTV对面酒店的台阶上，悠闲喝着啤酒，等待好戏开场。
没多久，三十多个黑衣壮汉气势汹汹走出帝豪KTV，领头的赫然是刘老板刘天虎，待刘天虎挥手正要指挥小弟杀往金大，帝豪两侧突然冲出近百个手持突击步枪、冲锋枪等武器的制服叔叔，且有十多个中红点瞄准众人，显然附近还有狙击手埋伏。
死胖子，说吧，香江哪个家族的？哪只爪子非礼了我妹妹？
你的地盘？要不我打个电话问问，这里是谁的地盘？
想起两个年轻人的话语，看向早已埋伏在帝豪附近的阿Sir，突击步枪、冲锋枪、轻机枪，对面楼上还有十多个狙击手，刘天虎脸色瞬间苍白一片，那两个年轻人才是真正的狠人，要彻底置他于死地！
想起小弟腰间有不少手枪，看向周围阿Sir的制服，金陵飞龙特种兵，金陵国安分局，刘天虎瞬间心如死灰，出来混迟早要还的，不由得仰天大笑起来，掏出腰间手枪，快速伸入口中。
砰，清脆的枪响声打破夜晚的宁静，李子茜、张思雯、柴书敏、方静怡等女瞬间打了个哆嗦，惊恐看向对面饮弹自尽的刘天虎，叱咤风云的一方枭雄，怎么就开枪自杀了呢。
江凡暗暗叹息，刘天虎身上不知道背了多少命案，如今又被查到私藏大量枪支弹药，等待他的命运只有死亡，与其被官方执行枪决，倒不如饮弹自尽，保留了枭雄最后一丝尊严！
扫了眼人畜无害的张兆庆，江凡默默同情刘天虎三秒，即使刘天虎的小弟们没有携带枪支，张兆庆也提前让六扇门准备了白面栽赃嫁祸，五十克枪毙，一包足够刘天虎被枪毙七八次。
不得不佩服几人背后强大的人脉关系网，绕开当地的公安系统，以涉黑、反恐的名义让特种部队和六扇门出手，出手直击死穴，再牛逼的黑道枭雄也难逃一死。
唉，一代枭雄就此落幕，秦淮再无虎爷，也不知道刘天虎自杀前那一刻在想什么，大概率不会是在后悔得罪江凡，而是后悔招惹得罪不起的二代或三代吧。
“好戏结束，也到了分赃的时候，那套别墅我就要了，这些钱你们拿去分。”
江凡打开两个皮包，一叠叠百元大钞出现在众人面前，不知道的还以为一伙人刚抢银行，在路边坐地分赃。
“江兄弟，你这不是打我们脸嘛，还没来得及感谢你，要是今晚没有你出手相救，那后果简直不敢想象。”
牧华伟举起酒瓶同江凡相碰，刘天虎和王胖子那是什么尿性，十成要把众女玷污，他和兆庆极有可能被沉江，救命之恩高于泰山，分钱那不是赤果果打大家脸嘛。
“江兄弟，大恩不言谢，有时间咱们三人好好大喝一顿，不醉不归！”
张兆庆举起酒瓶同两人相碰，感激看向江凡，得亏江凡战斗力逆天，即使他找到机会给二叔发短信求教，可等二叔敢到帝豪KTV的时候，恐怕黄花菜都凉了。
想起刘天虎丝毫不犹豫选择开枪自杀，众女依然心有余悸，如此杀伐果断的人，要是没有江凡出手相救，她们的下场简直不敢想象，纷纷举起啤酒，同江凡碰杯。
“江凡，这是那死胖子开的汇丰支票，这钱花起来膈应人，你就代劳帮我们花了。”
张思雯笑着说道，众女纷纷附和，大家又不缺钱，死胖子的钱又太膈应人，反正江凡又不嫌弃钱的来路。

大家也算患难与共，江凡也不客气，直接收下支票，众女要是花死胖子的钱，很有可能想起饮弹自尽的刘天虎，他就没什么忌讳了，恨不得跑到对面帝豪KTV的至尊包厢在抢点钱。
好好的生日宴会搞出这破事，特别是刘天虎在众人面前饮弹自尽，晚上回宿舍肯定难以入眠，众人商议一番，决定到新街口找家酒店开房通宵喝酒，大醉一场，一醉解千愁。
江凡可不想浪费宝贵修炼时间去通宵喝酒，把众人送到酒店，约好有时间一起再聚，打车前往玄武湖公园，拎着两皮包现金向山上奔袭，找到修炼的老地方，盘膝坐下，双手朝上，作抱元归一状，运转《混沌造化诀》，生命不止，修炼不止！
今晚对于很多人来说注定是个不眠夜，特种兵和六扇门联合清查帝豪KTV，纵横黑道十数年的枭雄刘天虎选择自杀，数十个小弟被六扇门带走调查，当晚帝豪停业整顿，警方又突袭检查各大娱乐场所，一时间闹的风风雨雨。
对于各大娱乐场所突击检查，没有收到任何消息的各方黑道大佬风声鹤唳，很快在第一时间便打听到帝豪KTV发生的事情，得知秦淮区地下王者刘天虎饮弹自尽，难免有些兔死狐悲的感觉。
没过多久，各方大佬再次打听到较为详细的消息，刘天虎从帝豪KTV二楼包厢带走七八个年轻客人，没人知道三楼的至尊包厢发生什么事情，前后也就半个多小时，帝豪被一群实枪荷弹的阿Sir包围，现场还有十多个狙击手。
不用想也能猜到大概发生了什么，绕过当地的公安系统，飞龙特种兵和六扇门出动营救，被刘天虎带走的那些年轻人中有人背景通天，刘天虎这是踢到钛合金钢板，把自己给折了进去。
各方大佬很想打听那帮年轻人的信息，以后见到那帮人也好绕道走，以免把自己也给折进去，可惜多方打听只是徒劳，只是得知同行的五个女生为极品女神。
正在金陵禄口国际机场等飞机的王胖子，同样在第一时间收到消息，得知刘天虎开枪自杀，帝豪被飞龙和六扇门突击查封，身体禁不住剧烈颤抖，简直不敢想象那几个年轻人背景有多厚。
王胖子暗暗庆幸立即离开那个是非之地，否则等待他的命运可能是牢底坐穿，想起之前让秘书注销那张开出去的百万支票，立即拿起手机拨打秘书电话，制止自己的作死行为。
暗暗庆幸的不仅仅只有王胖子，金狼帮一众成员犹如劫后重生，黑白两道混的风生水起虎爷饮弹自尽，数十个小弟被带走，帝豪被查封，连带各大娱乐场所被突击检查，，，
那几个年轻人背景通天，连秦淮地下王者虎爷也栽在她们头上，要是他们金狼帮去挑衅那几个年轻人，明年的今天，坟头草恐怕有一丈高了吧！

content_en:
After leaving Dihao KTV, Jiang Fan, Mu Huawei, Zhang Zhaoqing and others did not go far. They returned along the original road and sat on the steps of the hotel opposite Dihao KTV, drinking beer leisurely and waiting for the show to start.
Not long after, more than 30 strong men in black walked out of the Emgrand KTV aggressively. The leader was clearly Boss Liu Liu Tianhu. When Liu Tianhu waved his hand and was about to direct his younger brother to go to Jinda, nearly a hundred uniformed uncles armed with assault rifles, submachine guns and other weapons suddenly rushed out from both sides of the Emgrand. More than ten red dots were aimed at everyone. Apparently there were snipers ambush nearby.
Damn fat man, tell me, which family in Xiangjiang is from this family? Which paw molested my sister?
Your territory? How about I call and ask, whose territory is this?
Thinking of the words of the two young men, he looked at Sir who had already been ambushing Dihao with assault rifles, submachine guns, light machine guns, and more than a dozen snipers on the opposite floor. Liu Tianhu's face instantly turned pale. Those two young men were the real ruthless people, and they wanted to kill him completely!
Thinking of the many pistols in his younger brother's waist, and looking around at the uniforms of Sir, Jinling Feilong Special Forces, and Jinling National Security Bureau, Liu Tianhu instantly felt despair. He would have to pay them back sooner or later if he came out to work. He couldn't help but laugh to the sky, took out the pistol from his waist, and quickly stuck it into his mouth.
Bang, the crisp sound of gunshots broke the tranquility of the night. Li Ziqian, Zhang Siwen, Chai Shumin, Fang Jingyi and other women trembled instantly. They looked at Liu Tianhu who committed suicide by drinking a bullet across from him in horror. Why did the all-powerful hero shoot himself.
Jiang Fan secretly sighed, Liu Tianhu had been involved in countless murders, and now he was found to have hidden a large amount of guns and ammunition. The only fate waiting for him was death. Rather than being shot by the authorities, he might as well commit suicide by drinking bullets and retain the last trace of the hero's dignity!
Glancing at Zhang Zhaoqing, who was harmless to both humans and animals, Jiang Fan silently sympathized with Liu Tianhu for three seconds. Even though Liu Tianhu's younger brothers did not carry guns, Zhang Zhaoqing had six doors prepared in advance to frame him and frame him as the blame. They gave him 50 grams of gunfire, and one pack was enough for Liu Tianhu to be shot seven or eight times.
I have to admire the strong network of connections behind these people, bypassing the local public security system, and using the name of gang involvement and anti-terrorism to let the special forces and Liumen take action, striking directly at the critical point. No matter how awesome the underworld tycoon is, he will not escape death.
Alas, a generation of heroes has come to an end. There is no more Tiger Lord in Qinhuai, and I don’t know what Liu Tianhu was thinking at the moment before committing suicide. Most likely, he did not regret offending Jiang Fan, but regretted offending the second or third generation who could not afford to offend him.
"The show is over and it's time to divide the spoils. I want that villa. You can take the money and divide it."
Jiang Fan opened two leather bags, and stacks of hundred-dollar bills appeared in front of everyone. Those who didn't know it thought that a group of people had just robbed a bank and were sitting on the roadside to share the loot.
"Brother Jiang, didn't you slap us in the face? I haven't even had time to thank you. If you hadn't come to our rescue tonight, the consequences would be unimaginable."
Mu Huawei raised the bottle of wine and touched it with Jiang Fan. Liu Tianhu and Fatty Wang were peeing like that. They would probably taint all the girls. He and Zhaoqing were very likely to be drowned. The grace of saving lives was higher than Mount Tai. Sharing the money would not be a slap in the face for everyone.
"Brother Jiang, I won't thank you enough for your kindness. When we have time, the three of us will have a big drink and we won't come home until we get drunk!"
Zhang Zhaoqing raised his bottle and touched it to the two of them, looking at Jiang Fan gratefully. Thanks to Jiang Fan's incredible fighting ability, even if he found the opportunity to send a text message to his second uncle for advice, by the time his second uncle dared to go to Dihao KTV, the day lily would be cold.
Thinking of Liu Tianhusi's decision to shoot herself without hesitation, the girls were still frightened. For such a decisive and decisive person, if Jiang Fan hadn't come to the rescue, their fate would have been unimaginable. They all raised their beers and clinked glasses with Jiang Fan.
"Jiang Fan, this is the HSBC check written by that damn fat guy. This money is expensive to spend, so you can spend it for us."
Zhang Siwen said with a smile, everyoneThe women all agreed. We were not short of money, but the fat man's money was too embarrassing. Anyway, Jiang Fan didn't dislike the source of the money.
Everyone is sharing weal and woe, Jiang Fan is not polite and directly accepts the check. If the girls spend the fat man's money, they will probably think of Liu Tianhu who committed suicide by drinking a bullet. He has no taboos and wants to run to the supreme box of Dihao KTV opposite to grab some money.
After such a bad thing happened at a good birthday party, especially when Liu Tianhu committed suicide by drinking bullets in front of everyone, it would be difficult to sleep at night when he returned to the dormitory. After some discussion, everyone decided to find a hotel in Xinjiekou and stay up all night to drink and get drunk.
Jiang Fan didn't want to waste his precious training time drinking all night long, so he sent everyone to the hotel and made an appointment to get together again when they could. He took a taxi to Xuanwu Lake Park and rushed up the mountain with two bags of cash. He found his old training place, sat down cross-legged, with his hands facing up, as if he were holding one's body, and started to run the "Chaos Creation Technique". Life will not stop, and training will not stop!
Tonight is destined to be a sleepless night for many people. The special forces and Six Doors jointly raided Dihao KTV. Liu Tianhu, the tycoon who has been in the underworld for more than ten years, chose to commit suicide. Dozens of young men were taken away by Six Doors for investigation. That night, Emgrand closed down business for rectification, and the police raided and inspected major entertainment venues. There was a sudden uproar.
The gangsters from all sides who had not received any information about the sudden inspections of major entertainment venues were alarmed. They soon found out what happened at Dihao KTV and learned that Liu Tianhu, the underground king of Qinhuai District, committed suicide by drinking a bullet. It was inevitable that he would feel a bit sad.
Not long after, bosses from all parties once again inquired for more detailed information. Liu Tianhu took away seven or eight young guests from the second-floor box of Dihao KTV. No one knew what happened in the supreme box on the third floor. In just over half an hour, Dihao was surrounded by a group of Sirs with live guns and ammunition. There were more than a dozen snipers on the scene.
You can guess what happened without even thinking about it. Bypassing the local public security system, Feilong Special Forces and Liumen went out to rescue. Some of the young people taken away by Liu Tianhu had a background as high as the sky. Liu Tianhu kicked the titanium alloy steel plate and folded himself in.
Big bosses from all parties wanted to get information about that group of young people, so that they could take a detour when meeting them in the future, so as not to involve themselves. Unfortunately, all inquiries were in vain, and they only learned that the five girls who were traveling with them were top goddesses.
Fatty Wang, who was waiting for his flight at Jinling Lukou International Airport, also received the news immediately. He learned that Liu Tianhu shot himself and that Emgrand was raided by Feilong and Liumen. His body could not help but tremble violently. He could not imagine how rich the backgrounds of those young people were.
Fatty Wang was secretly glad to leave that place of right and wrong immediately, otherwise the fate that awaited him might be imprisonment. Remembering that he had asked his secretary to cancel the million-dollar check, he immediately picked up his cell phone and called his secretary to stop his suicide attempt.
It’s not just Fatty Wang who is secretly glad. All the members of the Golden Wolf Gang seem to have been reborn after a disaster. The black and white gangs are in trouble. Mr. Hu committed suicide by drinking a bullet. Dozens of his younger brothers were taken away, the Imperial Palace was sealed, and all major entertainment venues were raided.
Those young people have great backgrounds, and even the underground king of Qinhuai, Mr. Hu, fell on them. If the Golden Wolf Gang provokes those young people, the grass on their graves may be one foot high today next year!
